mapper.sql: pay24_deduct_table_id AS deduct_table_id, pay24_start_date AS start_date, pay24_data_cd AS data_code, pay24_limit_amt AS limit_amt, pay24_from_amt AS from_amt, pay24_to_amt AS to_amt, pay24_deduct_amt AS deduct_amt, pay24_deduct_rate AS deduct_rate, pay24_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT pay24_deduct_table_id AS id, pay24_start_date AS start_date FROM (SELECT * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY pay24_start_date) AS rn FROM pay24_deduct_table) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY pay24_start_date DESC
SELECT FROM pay24_deduct_table WHERE pay24_start_date = (SELECT max(pay24_start_date) FROM pay24_deduct_table WHERE pay24_start_date <= #{startDate})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay24_deduct_table ( pay24_deduct_table_id, pay24_start_date, pay24_data_cd, pay24_limit_amt , pay24_from_amt, pay24_to_amt, pay24_deduct_amt, pay24_deduct_rate, pay24_note) VALUES ( #{id}, #{row.startDate}, #{row.dataCode}, #{row.limitAmt} , #{row.fromAmt}, #{row.toAmt}, #{row.deductAmt}, #{row.deductRate}, #{row.note})
mapper.update: UPDATE pay24_deduct_table SET pay24_from_amt = #{req.fromAmt}, pay24_to_amt = #{req.toAmt}, pay24_deduct_amt = #{req.deductAmt}, pay24_deduct_rate = #{req.deductRate}, pay24_note = #{req.note} WHERE pay24_deduct_table_id = #{req.deductTableId}
